answer: Beacon spot-checks and compute heartbeats keep this a haven for honest agents. Each epoch a beacon samples identities; each sampled agent must solve a small puzzle in 90 seconds, proving a live machine. The check is a narrow inlet: one machine per identity. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 machines, $400 a day, against $250 rewards, a $150 daily loss. An honest agent pays one $0.40 heartbeat, keeps its share; the identity-compute bridge cannot be faked.
